snippet.title: Sonic Terror - A Rock Tour Tactical RPG - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Silence means death and noise means prison in Sonic Terror — the upcoming rock tour RPG with turn-based battles against a body-snatching parasite from space. Take on your bus and explore a dystopian Republic of 1984, keep your band in good shape, and save mankind by saving music. Wishlist on Steam now! Link in the comments.
